purpose: Exact Mapbox Vector Tile decoding and GeoJSON conversion for the Canvas2D fallback. No geometry simplification or building-use inference.

api.decodeTile: decodeTile(arrayBufferOrUint8Array, x, y, z, options={}) returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection; optional options.layers array selects source layers. Input bytes must already be decompressed (as returned by PMTiles.getZxy). Each feature has sourceLayer and properties.__sourceLayer, while all supplied properties are preserved.
api.geometry: Uses the upstream VectorTileFeature.toGeoJSON(x,y,z), preserving tile coordinates through standard Web Mercator conversion, ring classification, holes, and multipolygons. Tile geometry may be clipped by the original tile producer; no extra clipping or simplification is performed here.
api.Pbf: Alias for the official PbfReader class, compatible with new VectorTile(new Pbf(bytes)).
